big_story.headline: Bulls Defy Global AI Jitters
big_story.subhead: DALAL STREET REBOUNDS AS DOMESTIC BENCHMARKS SOAR DESPITE ASIAN TECH SELLOFF
paragraphs: Indian equity benchmarks staged a sharp rally in Wednesday morning trade, defying a global tech selloff that rattled Asian and US markets. The Sensex zoomed over 1,500 points intraday to 83,773.55, up 1.62%, while the Nifty 50 jumped 1.68% to reclaim the 25,750 level at 25,774.70. IT and Realty sectors led the gains on Dalal Street, providing strong support to the domestic market.

The domestic surge stands out against a sharp downturn in global equities driven by deepening AI stock corrections. Wall Street saw the NASDAQ drop 2% as Nvidia dipped 6%, while Asian tech giants like SoftBank plunged 14% amid growing investor anxiety over tech valuations. However, Indian sentiment was bolstered by steady foreign inflows and easing oil prices, insulating local equities from global technology jitters.

Market participants are closely tracking whether domestic buying can sustain the rally amid persistent international headwinds. While Metal and PSU Bank stocks lagged in today's session so far, strong leadership from blue-chip IT counters pushed indices closer to record highs. Investors will watch global economic cues and incoming domestic inflation data to see if Indian markets maintain their independent upward momentum.
big_story.pullbox: Indian equities displayed strong resilience as the Sensex zoomed 1,500 points intraday, showing how domestic momentum and foreign inflows can buffer local markets against global tech selloffs.

explains.title: What is Market Decoupling?
paragraphs: Market decoupling refers to a phenomenon where one financial market or economy moves independently from global market trends. While global stock exchanges may experience heavy selloffs due to specific sector pressures, a decoupled market continues to trend upward based on local fundamentals.

In practice, decoupling occurs when strong domestic investor flows, sector diversification, or macro tailwinds like lower commodity prices outweigh international headwinds. This allows regional indices to post gains even as international markets face severe volatility.

Indian fintech startup Vegapay has secured ₹38.4 crore in a Series A funding round led by global tech investor Prosus. The fresh capital infusion values the company at ₹380 crore as it expands its financial technology infrastructure solutions.

The investment comes as institutional backing for Indian fintech startups remains selective and focused on scalable infrastructure providers. Vegapay plans to deploy the capital to strengthen its core product offerings and expand enterprise client adoption.

story_1.headline: India-EU Free Trade Pact Nears December Signing
paragraphs: Prime Minister Narendra Modi held discussions with the German Chancellor as negotiations for the India-EU free trade agreement reach their final stages. The European Union Ambassador indicated that the trade pact is likely to be signed in December 2026. Official talks have accelerated ahead of the expected conclusion.

If signed on schedule, the comprehensive pact is expected to come into force by mid-2027. The agreement aims to strengthen bilateral economic ties and expand market access between India and European member states.

story_2.headline: Asian Tech Stocks Slide as AI Sell-Off Deepens
paragraphs: SoftBank Group shares plunged 14% as a Wall Street technology sell-off spilled into Asian equity markets. Investors retreated from major tech names following renewed concerns over valuation levels across artificial intelligence companies.
The sharp decline in technology stocks pulled down broader regional market indices across Asia, reversing gains from earlier sessions as cautious sentiment prevailed.

story_3.headline: Navy Plans ₹15,000-Crore Utility Helicopter Deal
paragraphs: The Indian Navy and Coast Guard are preparing a ₹15,000-crore proposal to acquire 76 utility helicopters. The procurement plan is intended to replace the military's ageing fleet of Cheetah and Chetak helicopters to modernize maritime security capabilities.

geopolitics.headline: Trump Weighs Fresh Tariffs on India and China
paragraphs: Donald Trump is weighing fresh trade tariffs targeting both India and China as part of a new US trade investigation into foreign commerce. The announcement triggered immediate market volatility in global trading, causing the NASDAQ 100 to drop 2% while Nvidia stock dipped 6%. The potential measures arrive as Washington prepares for major diplomatic engagements, including a planned Quad meeting.

Experts suggest the upcoming Quad meeting could help reinforce US-India strategic and economic ties ahead of bilateral discussions with Beijing. However, fresh tariff risks create uncertainty for Indian exporters and cross-border supply chains. Businesses are watching closely to see how Washington balances Indo-Pacific alliance-building with aggressive trade policy.

big_story.headline: India’s Space Economy to Hit $40-45 Billion on Private Boost
big_story.text: Union Minister Jitendra Singh announced that India's space economy is projected to reach $40-45 billion, powered by rapid expansion in the private sector. The government's push for private participation and commercial space ventures is expected to transform the nation's satellite and launch services ecosystem. For India, this signals a major shift toward high-tech exports and deep-tech innovation.

big_story.headline: Shadowfax Acquires WeFast for ₹23.3 Crore to Expand Logistics
big_story.text: Logistics company Shadowfax Technologies has approved the acquisition of WeFast assets for ₹23.3 crore to enter the fast-growing intra-city logistics market. The strategic deal allows Shadowfax to broaden its last-mile delivery network and compete directly in hyper-local transport. For India’s quick-commerce and supply chain sectors, this consolidation underscores rising demand for rapid urban logistics.

venture_vault.headline: Aeravti Ventures Launches ₹300 Crore Fund, Hits First Close
venture_vault.text: Early-stage venture firm Aeravti Ventures has launched its ₹300 crore second fund and already secured 50% of the target capital at first close. The fund aims to support tech-driven early-stage startups across emerging sectors in India. The successful first close reflects sustained investor appetite for domestic tech entrepreneurship despite global market headwinds.

venture_vault.headline: Foodlink F&B Sets ₹361-Crore IPO Price Band at ₹181-191 per Share
venture_vault.text: Hospitality and catering company Foodlink F&B Holdings has fixed its IPO price band at ₹181-191 per share for its ₹361-crore public issue opening on November 26. The funds will support expansion and corporate growth across its food service operations. The move highlights active retail and institutional investor interest in India's post-pandemic food and beverage sector.

geopolitics.headline: Linking ASEAN to IMEC: India’s East-West Trade Strategy
geopolitics.text: India is aligning its Act East policy with the India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC) to build an integrated East-West connectivity framework linking ASEAN nations. The strategy seeks to position India as a central hub for global supply chains and cross-border trade. For Indian markets, enhanced maritime and rail infrastructure promises to boost export competitiveness across Asia and Europe.

geopolitics.headline: CSIR and DAKSHIN Partner to Drive Tech Diplomacy in Global South
geopolitics.text: India’s CSIR has partnered with DAKSHIN for 2026 to advance the nation’s science and technology diplomacy across the Global South. The initiative focuses on sharing technical expertise, joint research, and sustainable development solutions with developing countries. This partnership strengthens India’s strategic influence as a leader in global innovation and soft-power diplomacy.
